2. The applicants who are the husband of the respondent no. 2 and his relatives are seeking quashment of Regular Criminal Case No. 69/2021 arising out of Crime No. 449/2021, registered with Chikalthana Police Station, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, at the instance of the respondent no. 2 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code are seeking quashment.

3. The respondent no. 2 has filed affidavit in reply inter alia mentioning the manner in which the matter has been amicably settled and expressly giving consent for quashment of the crime and the criminal case.
4. The learned advocates of both the sides request for quashment of the crime based on such settlement.
